_comment: One basket page per week, each published fresh by /courses and recorded here. /courses push reads the week's link from this file to find the push request. The page before 2026-09-14 served every week from one bookmarked URL; it is kept as oldSharedPage and no longer updated. The week of 2026-09-14 was published twice; Charlotte approved and pushed from AsuNh1…, and the link first recorded here (a531ad93…) is the copy she never used, kept under duplicates so nobody reads a push from it again. A third copy (96VqXg42…) was republished on 2026-09-16 from a branch, to try the Kitchen tab; she did not push from it, and its library/kitchen holds one statement, the cinnamon — her other answers there never stuck. The week of 2026-09-28 was republished on 2026-09-28 with the page-sync fix; its first page (1nWBax9…) reset her edits and is kept under duplicates, with its state copied across. Republished again on 2026-09-28 with the recipe sheet and the three-tab redesign (JCCFyub…); her decisions, swap and favourites were copied from W4fw6ej…, which is now under duplicates. The week of 26 October is the first in four weeks — there was no order between 29 September and then, so nothing was published for 5, 12 or 19 October. Its page was published once, with library/favourites (three stars) and library/recipe-edits (the citrus dressing on salade-pois-chiches) carried over from JCCFyub…; there is no weeks/2026-10-26 to copy, since the week is new.
